hypothesis: Reported call-versus-put trading activity relative to reported outstanding option positions predicts next-week futures direction.

source.aggregation: separate sums of finite reported volume and OI per date/asset/side; min_count=1; missing rows masked, never zero-imputed; report both pool sizes
source.partial_reporting_interpretation: reported-subset proxy only, not complete market volume or inventory
source.availability: current-vintage historical proxy: next calendar day 00:00 Moscow; source_date strictly before decision_date

signal.control_role: same availability mask without new option-volume information; not eligible for post-hoc promotion
signal.side_missing_or_total_nonpositive: unavailable, flat; no zero fill or fallback to older valid signal
signal.new_invalid_release: supersedes old release and masks the signal
signal.decision: end of completed factual MOEX decision session
signal.execution: next factual active-contract open strictly after decision
signal.holding: daily target from latest strictly prior weekly source until next source, staleness, invalid map or terminal flattening

execution.terminal: flat at last factual active-map effective date before 2026

screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE only; 5% is component screening, not replacement of 20-50% goal

validation.scheme: fixed-rule already-open development history; all five calendar years and both costs; no fit or folds selected by outcomes

limitations: Most option rows have missing volume or OI. Separate reported pools are explicit proxies; no assumption that NULL means zero.
Reported totals do not identify opening buys, aggressor direction, dealer net positions or actual hedging demand.
Weekly single-day snapshots are not full weekly trading volume; exact option expiry and futures mapping are not inferred.
Historical availability is a conservative current-vintage proxy, not original publication evidence.
Futures opens, fees and margin are historical research proxies, not observed BBO or broker fills.
Same history was used in other research; no independent holdout or verified profit claim.
forbidden_followups: invert signs or change windows, assets, size, missing-data policy or controls after outcomes
claim expiry pinning or dealer gamma from this dataset
read protected 2026 or restart paper bootstrap
